text: What if every sneeze was ten times stronger than the last one?
Sneeze one. Totally normal. About sixteen kilometers an hour.
Sneeze two. Hurricane-force wind. The cat is now in the kitchen.
Sneeze three. Faster than sound. Sonic boom. Every window on the street... gone.
Sneeze four. Faster than a rifle bullet. It punches a tunnel through the house across the street.
Sneeze five. That air is moving so fast, it could leave Earth's gravity behind.
Sneeze six. The recoil throws you backwards. Through your own wall.
Sneeze seven. A million times stronger. Tons of T N T worth of energy, and you're launched across the city.
And somewhere, very far away, someone whispers... bless you.
Follow. Next time, it's your hiccups.
